create_clip_mediapipe: create a ClipMediaPipe instance to build a media pipeline for CLIP image-text contrastive training on HPU
define_mediapipe_graph: define the media pipe graph that decodes images and applies crop mirror normalization for CLIP

generate_reader_output_info: generate output tensor info for the custom reader specifying batch size and text max length dimensions
